hero.eyebrow: Plan- und Imperiumplaner für Prosperous Universe
hero.title: Plan a base {accent} you build it.
hero.positioning: The definitive Prosperous Universe companion for all who love to strategize and optimise.
hero.lead: Know what a base earns, what it needs and when it pays back, before you spend anything on it. Then group your bases into an empire and see what it makes, burns and has to ship.
hero.example_note: The example needs no account. Registering takes a minute with the game open.
hero.image_alt: Der Plan-Editor für eine Eisenbasis auf Montem: Arbeitskräfte, Produktionsgebäude und Material I/O

whole.title: The whole plan
whole.text: One base on one screen: workforce, costs, storage, production and material flow, updating as you change it.

buildings.title: Add buildings
buildings.text: Pick buildings and recipes from what the planet offers. Each one shows efficiency, revenue, area and construction cost.

workforce.title: Staff it
workforce.text: Workforce needed against housing supplied, per tier, with the luxuries you choose to provide.

money.title: See the money
money.text: This iron base on Montem makes 19,312.82 a day and pays back in 63.79 days.

flow.title: Check the flow
flow.text: Material I/O lists what the base consumes and produces per day, and what each line is worth.

tabs.title: Go deeper
tabs.text: POPR, visitation frequency, construction cart, supply cart and repair analysis are one tab away.

materials.title: Pick your materials
materials.text: H2O, at least 21 a day. Add more materials, in any-of or all-of groups.

conditions.title: Set the conditions
conditions.text: Surface, fertility, gravity, pressure, temperature and the active COGC program.

matches.title: Read the matches
matches.text: 9 of 4576 planets, with their other resources, COGC and infrastructure.

create_plan.title: Start a plan
create_plan.text: The + button creates a plan on that planet.

compare.title: Compare up to four
compare.text: Pin planets with the star and see them side by side.

totals.title: One bottom line
totals.text: Revenue, cost and profit of all bases together: this empire makes 186,973.33 a day.

plans.title: Every plan side by side
plans.text: Each base with its planet, COGC and daily profit, and how many permits the empire uses.

material_io.title: Short or spare
material_io.text: Material I/O across all bases shows what the empire has to buy or ship in, and what it can sell.

tabs.title: Look further
tabs.text: Analysis and Production Opportunities are one tab away.

most_used.title: Where to settle, what pays back, and when a base runs dry.

planet_search.label: Planetensuche
planet_search.title: Finde den Planeten für deine nächste Basis.
planet_search.lead: Filtere jeden Planeten im Universum und starte deinen nächsten Plan.
planet_search.alt: Planetensuche: Filter auf der linken Seite, übereinstimmende Planeten mit ihren Ressourcen, COGC und Infrastruktur daneben

empire.label: Empire
empire.title: Run every base as one empire.
empire.lead: Put your plans together and see what the whole operation earns, and which materials it is short of or has spare.
empire.alt: Empire view: revenue, cost and profit, the list of plans, and material I/O across all bases

resource_roi.label: Ressourcen ROI
resource_roi.title: Sehe, welcher Planet sich am schnellsten auszahlt.
resource_roi.lead: Pick a resource and your exchange preference. Every planet that has it gets a costed plan: plan cost, daily profit and ROI in days, next to POPR, COGC, environment and infrastructure.
resource_roi.alt: Ressourcen-ROI für ALO: Planeten mit täglicher Produktion, Plankosten, täglicher Gewinn und ROI in Tagen

fio_burn.label: FIO Verbrauch
fio_burn.title: Erfahre, wann deine Basis keine Materialien mehr hat.
fio_burn.lead: Link your FIO account and Burn compares your real stock with what each plan uses: days left per material, thresholds you set, and a resupply list per base exported as XIT actions.
fio_burn.alt: FIO Verbrauch: Verbrauch pro Plan, mit einer erweiterten Basis, um deinen Verbrauch, Lagerbestand und die übrigen Tage pro Material anzuzeigen

starter.label: New to the game
starter.title: Start from a typical setup, then make it yours.
starter.text: An empty plan offers what other players typically plan on that planet. It is a guideline, not a rule: change every building and recipe until you have found your own best setup.

shared.label: Shared plans
shared.title: Send a plan as a link.
shared.text: Anyone with the link can see the recipes and try changes, without an account. Good for asking your corporation for feedback.

setup.title: From first base to empire.

hq_calculator.label: HQ Kalkulator

what.question: What is PRUNplanner?
what.answer: PRUNplanner is a free, open source planning tool for the browser game Prosperous Universe (PrUn). You plan bases and whole empires in it, find planets, compare what pays back and see when a base runs out of materials.

free.question: Is PRUNplanner free?
free.answer: Yes. There are no ads and no paid tier. The code is on GitHub.

fio.question: Do I need FIO to use it?
fio.answer: No. Plans, empires, Planet Search, Resource ROI and the calculators work without it. FIO Burn and Repair read your real in-game stock and buildings, so those two need a linked FIO account.

try.question: Can I try it without an account?
try.answer: Yes. Open the example plan: you can change buildings and recipes and see the numbers update. You need an account to save plans of your own.

official.question: Is it an official Prosperous Universe tool?
official.answer: No. It is a community project made by a player and is not made by the game's developer.

languages.question: Which languages does it support?
languages.answer: English and {count} more, translated by players on Crowdin.

closing.title: Plan your next base {accent}
closing.text: Over {players} players already do. Free, open source and translated by players. Registering takes a minute with the game open.
